theorem.side_encoding: For signed NAE3, each row is exactly a*x = ell(a)+s with s in {0,1}.
theorem.snf_filter: For a full-rank row basis B, integer liftability is exactly the Smith divisibility system on U(ell+s).
theorem.firewall: Integer liftability does not by itself imply x is Boolean.

frozen_microcore.conclusion: The determinant-13 basis is satisfiable; one residual row kills both torsion-compatible Boolean lifts.

active_gate.target: Polynomial-size exact composition of Smith/torsion side-code states across signed-hole interaction blocks without side-word enumeration.
